prompt.en: Sohan planted two types of sugarcane stem pieces: type A without a node and type B with a node. Only type B sprouted. What did Sohan observe to decide whether the node made a difference? Name things he should keep the same for both types, so that the comparison is fair.

level1.en: What did Sohan look for in each piece after a few weeks?

clue.en: He checked each piece to see whether it grew new shoots.

level2Template.en: Sohan observed whether each piece ___ after a few weeks.

level1.en: Apart from the node, what else could make one piece grow better than another?

clue.en: The length of the pieces, the soil, the water, the light, the planting depth and the age of the cane should all be the same.

level2Template.en: Both types should have the same ___, so that only the node is different.

text.en: Sohan checked whether each piece sprouted and grew into a plant after a few weeks.
Both types should have the same length, soil, water, light, planting depth and age of cane, so that only the node is different.
